messages.label: Community post (Reddit / Discord)
messages.message: I tested whether AI video actually follows a previs camera move. Grey-box previs → Seedance 2.0 Mini on Higgsfield, 7 moves (POV walk, dutch roll, slow pan, whip pan, tilt reveal, dolly zoom, orbit). All 7 followed; the dutch roll came back at 43.9° vs 44.4° planned. Side-by-sides and method: {{SITE_URL}}#proof. The tool is free to use. Happy to answer questions about the workflow.
